name: HasDerivWithinAt.iterate
statement: 𝕜 → 𝕜} {f' : 𝕜} (hf : HasDerivWithinAt f f' s x) (hx : f x = x) (hs : MapsTo f s s) (n : ℕ) : HasDerivWithinAt f^[n] (f' ^ n) s x

name: HasStrictDerivAt.iterate
statement: 𝕜 → 𝕜} {f' : 𝕜} (hf : HasStrictDerivAt f f' x) (hx : f x = x) (n : ℕ) : HasStrictDerivAt f^[n] (f' ^ n) x
